lines.en: I run along the branches without stopping.

lines.en: The branch is thin; I know it'll hold.
I slip down the trunk, quick.

lines.zh: 我在等一个更安全的时间
lines.en: I'm waiting for a safer moment.
The smell of autumn is strong.

lines.en: That hat of yours looks like it could hide things.

lines.en: We share this wood, on different levels.

lines.zh: 这一下打歪了，可还是疼
lines.en: It landed off-center, and still hurt.
I climb higher.
Nuts, I smell them.

lines.zh: 枫叶林里，另一条尾巴在动
lines.en: Another tail moves in the maple wood.
We chase each other round the trunk.

Before spring, it's still early.

lines.zh: 我把最好的果子藏给它
lines.en: I stash the best fruit for it.

The nest is high in the fork.

lines.zh: 别看了，这不是给人看的
lines.en: Don't watch; this isn't for people.
Our calls are very short.
In a few days we go our ways again.

lines.zh: 火烧到尾巴，我原地打转
lines.en: Fire caught my tail and I spun in place.

lines.zh: 摔下去，落地翻身就爬起来
lines.en: I fell, rolled, and was up again.
My fur soaked and I swim slowly.
The blast knocked me off the branch.
An arrow grazed my back, leaving a hot line.

lines.zh: 法术打过来，我毛都炸了
lines.en: The spell hit and my fur puffed out.
Too hungry to jump.

lines.zh: 雷落到树上，我整只麻了
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree and I went numb.
No tree below, only dark.
